title: Lanes cannot be shaded as bands or separated by a gap
foundBy: session agent of a consuming timeline page, measuring a headless Chromium render; relayed by the repository owner

evidence.verified: The browser test that shades neighbouring lanes as one band passes. Two lanes sharing a token make one band element. Its top is the first label's top and its bottom the second's. It runs from the labels' left edge to the scroller's right edge. A third lane with `gapBefore: 8` sits 8 pixels lower and takes a band of its own. The gutter's background is transparent. On the consuming page the run view has 4 bands, one per alternate member, and 5 with a member selected. Each runs from 33 to 931 pixels, the labels' left edge to the scroller's right. A band's top equals its member's label top with the inset set to 0rem. `npm run ci` passes on 791cdaa, with every gate run. The visual gate passes 116 of 116 captures with no differing pixel and no new axe finding. The positioned fixture was re-recorded in 8566fe8. The dense, multi-lane and bar fixtures of the index layout are byte-identical to the baseline before this work. The build was served through `npm run registry:npmrevs` as 0.3.1-dev.20260922083722.8566fe8 and installed into the consuming dispatch viewer. That viewer's run14-1 render was measured in headless Chromium at 1500 by 1000.

resolution: A lane takes `shade`, a token drawn as a band behind it from the gutter to the end of the axis. Neighbouring lanes of one token merge into one band. A lane also takes `gapBefore`, empty space above it that no band covers and no pointer hits. The bands are elements behind the whole grid, so a page's own space before the axis is shaded through. A band's top sits under the rows' top border. `--event-lanes-band-inset` moves it for a page that changes the border, as a length.
details:
A member's rows read as one band when they share a shade, alternating from one to the next, with a gap between neighbours. The component offers neither.

The consuming page paints a vertical gradient behind the lanes and the gutter, with a stop at each edge of each rendered label row. The gaps are empty 8-pixel lanes the page inserts between members. The gradient has to be re-measured whenever the rows change, and a lane whose height the component silently replaced misaligned every band beneath it.

A lane should be able to carry a shade token and a space before it. The band should run from the gutter to the end of the axis, so it stays continuous through any space the page keeps before the axis. The selected member's band in the accent shade is the same option with another token.
